name: ansible-inventory-cmdb
description: Every Cloudflare command for this project is an npm script here. wrangler is pinned below so it needs no global install; dev/deploy go through pywrangler because the Worker is Python.

scripts.bucket: npx wrangler r2 bucket create ansible-inventory-cmdb
scripts.domain: npx wrangler r2 bucket domain add ansible-inventory-cmdb --domain cmdb.kierangee.au --zone-id $CF_ZONE_ID --min-tls 1.2
scripts.deploy: uv run pywrangler deploy --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
